chunks: 2549 - And it is narrated from Yaʿqūb ibn Shuʿayb, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: "A man enters iḥrām for a hajj and an ʿumrah, and he begins the ʿumrah—does he perform tamattuʿ?" He said: "Yes."

key_terms.يُحْرِمُ: enters into the state of iḥrām for pilgrimage rites

ai.seo_question: If someone enters iḥrām for both hajj and ʿumrah and starts with the ʿumrah, is it considered tamattuʿ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a pilgrim who enters iḥrām for both hajj and ʿumrah and begins with the ʿumrah. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام confirms that such a person performs tamattuʿ, making the report relevant to the fiqh of the types of hajj.
